### Frequently Asked Questions

How can I start the 7-day Pro free trial?

Select the Pro plan and click “Start 7-day free trial.” You can start the trial after adding a valid credit card. The trial gives you access to Pro for 7 days and includes 500 Base Credits. You will not be charged when the trial begins. After the trial, your subscription will automatically renew based on your selected billing cycle at $10 per month or $96 per year, plus applicable taxes. To avoid renewal, please cancel at least one day before the trial ends.

Can I cancel my subscription at any time?

Yes. You can cancel your subscription at any time from your [Profile](https://www.codebuddy.ai/profile/plans-usage). After cancellation, your subscription will no longer renew automatically, but you can continue using your current plan and its remaining included quota until the end of the current billing period.

Will benefits marked “promo” always be available?

No. Benefits marked “promo,” such as daily activity rewards, temporarily increased code completion limits, automated task limits, and model access, are available for a limited time. Please refer to the official website and subsequent notices for any changes.

How are daily activity credits awarded?

You are considered active for the day if you start at least one conversation in the client. The corresponding credits will be added to your account on the following day, [View Details](https://www.codebuddy.ai/docs/ide/Account/Subscription#limited-time-daily-active-bonus-details).
